499 6/8/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
August 4th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,

Yesterday General Yang received a telegram from
Chianchun Feng Kou Chang 馮國璋 saying that the
latter had received telegraphic information from
Huang Hsin that serious trouble would take place
in Shanghai within the next three days.
General Yang had the telegram taken to Huang
Hsin who denied having sent any such message.
The Lungwha officials now suspect that some
of the pro-Manchu party in Shanghai sent the
telegram in Huang Hsin's name. In consequence of
the information, General Yang instructed the men
under his command to take special precautions
last night.
It is reported that a number of disbanded
soldiers who are natives of Shantung have come
lately to Shanghai in the hope of finding employment.
Admiral Sah Tsung Ping arrived by train
last evening from the Capital.

Your Obedient Servant,

[Signature]

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

[Signature] [Signature] 4/8/16.

499 16/8/6
上海工部局。
1916年8月4日
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

昨日，杨将军收到来自冯国璋（Chianchun Feng Kou Chang）的电报，称后者从黄兴处收到电报信息，获悉未来三天内上海将发生严重骚乱。
杨将军将该电报拿给黄兴看，黄兴否认曾发出此类消息。
龙华当局现在怀疑，是上海部分亲满派人士以黄兴的名义发送了该电报。鉴于此情报，杨将军已指令其部下于昨晚采取特别预防措施。
据报，近期有一批籍贯为山东的退伍士兵来到上海，希望寻找工作。
萨镇冰海军上将昨晚乘火车从京城抵达。

您的顺从仆人，

[签名]

总探长。

警务处巡官。

[签名] [签名] 16/8/4。
